name: Topzidi Admin Header
author: tecnotopzidi

sections.description:
Topzidi Admin Header lets you add a custom branded banner (image or logo) to the top of your WordPress admin dashboard. This is useful for agencies, developers, and site owners who want to give client dashboards a professional, branded look.

Features:

  • Upload or select a header image/logo using the native WordPress media library.
  • Optionally make the banner clickable by linking it to any URL.
  • Control the banner height and background color.
  • Choose to show the banner on the dashboard or across all admin pages.
  • Optionally hide the WordPress admin bar (top toolbar) on the front end for Subscribers.
  • Clean removal: no leftover settings pages if you deactivate the plugin (data is only removed if you use an uninstall routine you add yourself, or manually via Settings).

No coding required — configure everything from Settings > Admin Header.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the topzidi-admin-header folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Admin Header to upload your banner image and configure options.
sections.faq:
Does this affect the front end of my site?

No. This plugin only affects the WordPress admin dashboard area, not the public-facing website.

Can I remove the banner without deactivating the plugin?

Yes. Simply clear the image field on the Settings > Admin Header page and save.

What image size should I use?

A wide banner image (for example 1400×100 pixels) or a standard logo works well. You can also control the display height from the settings page.
